description: Shared Renovate preset for nf-* pipelines and nf-sub-* subworkflows. Drives semver-aware propagation of nf-mod-* git-submodule updates.

customManagers.description: Track nf-mod-* git submodules by tag, not by branch HEAD. Requires the .gitmodules entry to use `url = <repo>#<tag>` syntax (see Gaige pattern).

packageRules.description: PATCH bumps of nf-mod-* submodules: no propagation. Disabled entirely.
MINOR bumps of nf-mod-* submodules: auto-PR, group, and automerge. The consumer repo's release workflow should then bump its own MINOR.
MAJOR bumps of nf-mod-* submodules: no automatic propagation. The module repo's release workflow opens a tracking issue here instead.
